videos.description: Orange ball held steady on the black Stewart platform plate while the servo legs correct below it; edge LEDs switch to green near the end.
Wide desk shot of the Stewart platform balancing a ball in the dark, with live ball-position and IK plots on the monitors behind it.
Matplotlib trajectory planner animating position, velocity and acceleration profiles and the setpoint dot moving on the platform circle (white-background plots).
Portrait shot of a finger pressing on the force-torque sensor while the monitor plots the estimated contact position as a yellow dot.
Stewart platform prototype on the desk tilting while the monitor shows the live 3D inverse-kinematics leg plot.
Sped-up timelapse of hands assembling the acrylic Stewart platform: servo mounts, linkages, then the top plate with LED ring.
SolidWorks blue-line kinematic skeleton of the platform, with the top plate tilting as the legs are dragged (light background).
Simscape ball-on-plate simulation in four views with the plate tilting to centre an orange ball (grey background).
Portrait close-up of the white 3D-printed beam balancer holding an orange ping-pong ball in place while it is nudged with a pen.
Rendered turntable of the automated measurement device on black: screen enclosure, gantry tower and hex-grid part tray rotating into view.
MuJoCo simulation of a Franka Panda arm reaching toward randomly placed coloured target spheres on a blue checkered floor.
Six-cylinder radial engine CAD motion study with translucent cylinders and the crank spinning, on a wooden base (white background).
Close-up of the FTC 16397 robot with purple underglow driving and handling orange rings on the field mat.
Slow-motion top-down view of the FTC robot's flywheel shooter firing orange rings out of the chassis.
The Trashminator surface trash-collecting robot floating on an icy river with its conveyor intake in the water.
CAD animation moving over a blue/red swerve drive module, closing in on the rack-and-pinion gears and stepper motor.

images.description: Casual selfie of Armaan smiling in front of a robot/demo setup.
Photo of the measurement device prototype beside its CAD render: screen enclosure, part tray and camera tower.
Render of a stacked-plate actuator assembly driven by a purple 70 kg brushless servo (appears to be a rocketry canard actuator, not the inspection setup).
Simulink block diagram of a feedback control loop (not linkage CAD).
Render of the white beam balancer with a ball on the beam and the servo at the pivot.
Render of the FTC 16397 robot with green flywheel/intake mechanisms and purple side panels.
Armaan in a team shirt presenting the FTC robot at a judging table.
FTC SIM Virtual Robotics Adventure banner with a cartoon robot on an orange field (not subsystem CAD).
Row of team logos: Relatively Quantum 16397, Disco Bots and a robot mascot (logo graphic, not a championship photo).
Collage of the Fyelabs actuating enclosure: CAD views, internal electronics and the open case.
Render of the black actuating case with its outer cover raised.
Render of a long blue PCB on black (not a flux graph).
Render of a brushed-metal sensor enclosure on black (not a control-flow diagram).
HMI unit with a touchscreen showing a red/green zone display, beside its blue PCB.
Render of the actuating case with its outer cover lowered (not a lidar visualizer).
Black IXANA wordmark on a transparent background (not a block diagram; invisible on a dark page).
Ixana early prototype electronics: battery, flex PCBs and camera module, captioned as last year's CES demo / early prototypes.
3D lidar point cloud coloured by height, blue to red.
Crack-detection algorithm flowchart with angle-bucket averaging tables.
Strain curves from multiple sensors all detecting a crack, with algorithm flowchart thumbnails.
Dashboard of per-sensor strain waveform plots with the detection flowchart below.
Plot of strain waveforms across many strokes with one deviating curve (not a queue diagram).
Plot of strain waveforms across many strokes showing a crack signature.
MuJoCo render of a Franka Panda arm grasping a red object on a blue checkered floor.
FEA stress plot of a blue clamping hub with yellow/red stress concentrations (not the radial engine).
Render of The Canard-ian flight-computer PCB on black (not airbrakes CAD).
PCB layout view of The Canard-ian board with copper traces (not a cam mechanism).
Collage of The Canard-ian PCB render with its layout, schematic and simulation plots.
Render of The Canard-ian PCB on black (not a CFD simulation).
Collage of segway dynamics: free-body diagram, equations, Simulink blocks and surface plots.
Typeset equations of motion with C1-C7 coefficient terms (not a sensor photo).
Free-body/kinematics line diagram of a pivoting link system with labelled forces.
Dark photo of the Stewart platform with a ball on the plate and servo legs below.
Collage: IK 3D plot, Simulink plant and controller, and the force-moment sensor.
Free-body diagram of a link pivoting about O with labelled forces and moments (not a Simscape block).
Formal portrait of Armaan in a maroon suit on black (not a clamping hub).
Line-callout illustration of a Tesla Semi and Cybercab highlighting their lighting.
Render of the six-cylinder radial engine on a wooden base (not the Trashminator).
